statement: The three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem. Resolves the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem: every $`W^{1,p}`$ homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ<sup>3</sup>, for $`1\le p\lt \infty`$, is a strong $`W^{1,p}`$ limit of smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.
